facts.fact: La Sentinelle reports that Algeria's national all-fibre strategy aims to generalise FTTH across the whole territory by 2027, with the copper network phased out by the same date; the document gives no period that has ended and names no successor, and the strategy's adoption date is not stated (reported 2026-10-01, ministry communique of 2026-09-30).
